features.description: Proxy for swing speed; racket speed itself needs the implement adapter
Racket-hand height relative to the shoulder in torso lengths; negative = above the shoulder (racket prepared high)
RMS jerk of the racket hand path; lower is smoother
Shoulder rotation toward the side wall using model depth; depth ambiguity is a known failure mode
Whole-body stillness proxy (sideways in the image); not a centre of mass
Vertical hip movement in the image: travel toward or away from a front/back camera
Travel in any image direction (max of horizontal and vertical hip variability)
1.0 when the legs reach peak speed before the racket arm
